ko.title: 하루에 두 번 흔들린 해안: 인도네시아 플로레스섬을 황폐화한 지진의 내막

segments.src: A powerful magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, killing more than 50 people and injuring hundreds more, according to national disaster officials.
segments.tr: 강력한 규모 7.7의 지진이 인도네시아 동부 플로레스섬 해안 인근에서 발생했으며, 국가 재난 담당자에 따르면 50명 이상이 사망하고 수백 명이 부상당했다.

segments.src: The quake, one of the strongest to hit the region in years, was followed by more than 230 aftershocks and, hours later, a second major tremor that shook the island of Sumatra thousands of kilometers away — turning a single day into one of the most severe tests of Indonesia's emergency response systems in recent memory.
segments.tr: 이 지진은 수년 만에 이 지역을 강타한 가장 강한 지진 중 하나였으며, 230회 이상의 여진이 뒤따랐고, 수 시간 후 수천 킬로미터 떨어진 수마트라섬을 흔든 두 번째 대규모 지진이 발생했다 — 하루를 인도네시아 비상 대응 체계에 대한 최근 기억 속 가장 심각한 시험으로 만들었다.

segments.src: ## A Sudden, Violent Shock
segments.tr: ## 갑작스럽고 격렬한 충격

segments.src: The initial quake struck without warning, its epicenter located beneath the seabed near Flores, a mountainous island in the Nusa Tenggara region known for its volcanic terrain and small coastal communities.
segments.tr: 초기 지진은 전조 없이 발생했으며, 진앙은 플로레스 근처 해저에 위치했다. 플로레스는 누사 텡가라 지역의 산악 섬으로 화산 지형과 작은 해안 공동체로 알려져 있다.

segments.src: Indonesia's Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) issued a tsunami advisory in the immediate aftermath, prompting evacuations along low-lying shorelines before the warning was later downgraded.
segments.tr: 인도네시아 기상청(BMKG)은 즉시 후에 쓰나미 경고를 발령했으며, 낮은 해안선을 따라 대피를 촉구했다가 나중에 경고를 완화했다.

segments.src: The shaking was strong enough to collapse older masonry buildings, damage schools and health clinics, and trigger landslides that buried sections of the island's main coastal roads.
segments.tr: 진동은 오래된 벽돌 건물을 붕괴시키고, 학교와 보건소에 피해를 입히며, 섬의 주요 해안도로 구간을 묻은 산사태를 유발할 정도로 강했다.

segments.src: Officials with Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) reported that thousands of residents were displaced, many now sheltering in temporary camps, mosques, and community halls as search-and-rescue teams work to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: 인도네시아 국가재난관리청(BNPB) 관계자들은 수천 명의 주민이 이재민이 되었다고 보고했으며, 수색 및 구조팀이 고립된 마을에 도달하기 위해 노력하는 동안 많은 사람들이 임시 캠프, 모스크, 공동회관에서 피신 중이라고 했다.

segments.src: ## Aftershocks Complicate the Response
segments.tr: ## 여진이 대응을 복잡하게 만들다

segments.src: What has made this disaster especially difficult to manage is the sheer volume of aftershocks that followed — more than 230 by some counts, according to seismic monitoring agencies.
segments.tr: 이 재난을 특히 관리하기 어렵게 만든 것은 뒤따른 여진의 엄청난 규모이다 — 지진 모니터링 기관에 따르면 어떤 집계로는 230회 이상이다.

segments.src: Each new tremor has slowed rescue efforts, forcing crews to repeatedly pause work on unstable structures and landslide-blocked routes out of concern for further collapses.
segments.tr: 새로운 각 여진은 구조 활동을 둔화시켰으며, 추가 붕괴 우려로 인해 구조팀들이 불안정한 구조물과 산사태로 막힌 경로의 작업을 반복해서 중단하도록 강제했다.

segments.src: Emergency responders have relied on heavy equipment to clear debris from roads connecting Flores' interior communities to coastal hospitals, but mountainous terrain and damaged infrastructure have made some areas reachable only on foot or by helicopter.
segments.tr: 응급 대응 요원들은 플로레스의 내륙 지역사회와 해안 병원을 연결하는 도로의 잔해를 치우기 위해 중장비에 의존했지만, 산악 지형과 손상된 인프라로 인해 일부 지역은 도보나 헬리콥터로만 접근할 수 있었다.

segments.src: Local authorities say the priority remains locating survivors, restoring access to remote villages, and delivering clean water, food, and medical supplies to displaced families.
segments.tr: 지역 당국은 우선순위가 생존자 수색, 외딴 마을로의 접근성 복구, 그리고 이재민 가족들에게 깨끗한 물, 음식, 의료 물품 전달에 있다고 말했다.

segments.src: ## A Second Quake, Far Away
segments.tr: ## 두 번째 지진, 멀리서

segments.src: Hours after the Flores earthquake, a separate significant tremor struck near Sumatra, an island more than 2,000 kilometers to the west.
segments.tr: 플로레스 지진 수 시간 후, 서쪽으로 2,000km 이상 떨어진 수마트라섬 근처에서 별개의 상당한 지진이 발생했다.

segments.src: While authorities have not linked the two events directly, the near-simultaneous disasters strained national resources already stretched thin by the Flores response, requiring BNPB to coordinate relief efforts across two regions at once.
segments.tr: 당국이 두 사건을 직접 연결하지는 않았지만, 거의 동시에 발생한 재난은 이미 플로레스 대응으로 팽팽해진 국가 자원에 부담을 주었으며, BNPB가 두 지역의 구호 활동을 동시에 조율해야 했다.

segments.src: Seismologists note that such back-to-back events, while striking in their timing, are not unusual for Indonesia, which straddles the Pacific Ring of Fire — a horseshoe-shaped zone stretching around the Pacific Basin where the majority of the world's earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
segments.tr: 지진학자들은 이러한 연이은 사건들이 시간상 인상적이지만 태평양 환태평양화산대를 걸치고 있는 인도네시아에는 드문 일이 아니라고 지적한다 — 태평양 분지 주변을 둘러싼 말굽 모양의 지역으로 세계 지진과 화산 폭발의 대부분이 발생한다.

segments.src: The archipelago sits at the junction of several tectonic plates, making seismic activity a near-constant feature of life for its more than 270 million residents.
segments.tr: 이 열도는 여러 판의 교점에 위치하고 있어 지진 활동이 270백만 명 이상의 주민들의 생활에 거의 끊임없는 특징이 되도록 만든다.

segments.src: ## Testing a Familiar System Under New Strain
segments.tr: ## 새로운 부담 아래 익숙한 시스템 시험하다

segments.src: Indonesia has built one of the more experienced disaster-response frameworks in the world, shaped by decades of earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and the catastrophic 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
segments.tr: 인도네시아는 수십 년간의 지진, 화산 폭발, 그리고 2004년 인도양 쓰나미 재앙으로 형성된 세계에서 가장 경험 많은 재난 대응 체계 중 하나를 구축했다.

segments.src: Early-warning networks, community evacuation drills, and rapid-deployment rescue units have all been refined in the years since.
segments.tr: 초기 경보 네트워크, 지역사회 대피 훈련, 신속 배치 구조팀은 그 이후 수년간 모두 개선되었다.

segments.src: Even so, officials acknowledge that the combination of a high-magnitude quake, a prolonged aftershock sequence, and a second major event on the same day represents an unusually demanding scenario.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고, 관계자들은 높은 규모의 지진, 오래 지속되는 여진 수열, 그리고 같은 날 두 번째 대규모 사건의 조합이 특이하게 까다로운 상황을 나타낸다고 인정했다.

segments.src: The government has mobilized military and volunteer personnel to support local first responders, while international aid organizations have begun coordinating with Indonesian authorities to assess additional needs.
segments.tr: 정부는 지역 응급 대응자들을 지원하기 위해 군 인원과 자원봉사자를 동원했으며, 국제 구호 단체들은 추가 필요사항을 평가하기 위해 인도네시아 당국과 조율을 시작했다.

segments.src: Officials caution that damage assessments are still ongoing and that casualty and displacement figures may continue to rise as rescue teams reach areas that remain cut off.
segments.tr: 관계자들은 손상 평가가 아직 진행 중이며 구조팀이 고립된 지역에 도달함에 따라 사상자와 이재민 수치가 계속 증가할 수 있다고 경고했다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 다음은 무엇인가

segments.src: For now, the focus remains on the immediate humanitarian response: reopening roads, stabilizing damaged buildings, and ensuring displaced families have access to shelter and medical care as aftershocks continue to ripple through the region.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 초점이 즉각적인 인도주의적 대응에 있다: 도로 재개, 손상된 건물 안정화, 그리고 여진이 계속 지역을 통해 파급되는 동안 이재민 가족들이 대피소와 의료 서비스에 접근할 수 있도록 보장하기.

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: 장기적으로, 이 재난은 지구상에서 가장 지진 활동이 활발한 지역 중 하나인 건축 규정, 초기 경보 인프라, 그리고 대비 자금 조달에 관한 논의를 새롭게 할 것으로 예상된다 — 환태평양화산대를 따라 사는 공동체들에게 복원력은 일회성 성취가 아니라 지속적인 노력이라는 상기이다.

zh.title: 一日两震：印度尼西亚弗洛雷斯岛地震内幕

segments.src: A powerful magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, killing more than 50 people and injuring hundreds more, according to national disaster officials.
segments.tr: 据印度尼西亚国家灾难官员称，一场7.7级强地震袭击了东印度尼西亚弗洛雷斯岛附近海岸，造成50多人死亡，数百人受伤。

segments.src: The quake, one of the strongest to hit the region in years, was followed by more than 230 aftershocks and, hours later, a second major tremor that shook the island of Sumatra thousands of kilometers away — turning a single day into one of the most severe tests of Indonesia's emergency response systems in recent memory.
segments.tr: 这场地震是近年来袭击该地区最强的地震之一，随后发生了230多次余震，几小时后，又在数千公里外的苏门答腊岛发生了第二次主要地震，这使同一天成为了印度尼西亚近年来最严峻的应急响应系统考验。

segments.src: ## A Sudden, Violent Shock
segments.tr: ## 突然而猛烈的冲击

segments.src: The initial quake struck without warning, its epicenter located beneath the seabed near Flores, a mountainous island in the Nusa Tenggara region known for its volcanic terrain and small coastal communities.
segments.tr: 初次地震毫无预警地发生，震中位于弗洛雷斯附近的海床下方，弗洛雷斯是努沙登加拉地区的一个山地岛屿，以其火山地形和小型沿海社区而闻名。

segments.src: Indonesia's Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) issued a tsunami advisory in the immediate aftermath, prompting evacuations along low-lying shorelines before the warning was later downgraded.
segments.tr: 印度尼西亚气象气候和地球物理机构（BMKG）在地震发生后立即发布了海啸警告，促使低洼海岸线沿岸进行疏散，随后警告等级被下调。

segments.src: The shaking was strong enough to collapse older masonry buildings, damage schools and health clinics, and trigger landslides that buried sections of the island's main coastal roads.
segments.tr: 地震强度足以摧毁旧砌体建筑，损坏学校和卫生诊所，并引发泥石流埋没岛屿主要沿海道路的部分地段。

segments.src: Officials with Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) reported that thousands of residents were displaced, many now sheltering in temporary camps, mosques, and community halls as search-and-rescue teams work to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: 印度尼西亚国家灾难管理机构（BNPB）的官员报告称，数千名居民流离失所，许多人现在在临时营地、清真寺和社区大厅避难，搜救队正在努力到达孤立的村庄。

segments.src: ## Aftershocks Complicate the Response
segments.tr: ## 余震使应对变得复杂

segments.src: What has made this disaster especially difficult to manage is the sheer volume of aftershocks that followed — more than 230 by some counts, according to seismic monitoring agencies.
segments.tr: 使这场灾难特别难以管理的是随之而来的大量余震——根据地震监测机构的统计，超过230次。

segments.src: Each new tremor has slowed rescue efforts, forcing crews to repeatedly pause work on unstable structures and landslide-blocked routes out of concern for further collapses.
segments.tr: 每一次新的震动都减缓了救援工作，迫使救援队员因害怕进一步坍塌而反复暂停在不稳定建筑物和滑坡阻塞路线上的工作。

segments.src: Emergency responders have relied on heavy equipment to clear debris from roads connecting Flores' interior communities to coastal hospitals, but mountainous terrain and damaged infrastructure have made some areas reachable only on foot or by helicopter.
segments.tr: 应急响应人员依靠重型设备清除连接弗洛雷斯内陆社区与沿海医院的道路上的碎片，但山地地形和受损基础设施使某些地区只能徒步或乘直升机到达。

segments.src: Local authorities say the priority remains locating survivors, restoring access to remote villages, and delivering clean water, food, and medical supplies to displaced families.
segments.tr: 当地官员表示，优先事项仍然是定位幸存者、恢复与偏远村庄的联系、以及向流离失所的家庭提供清洁水、食物和医疗用品。

segments.src: ## A Second Quake, Far Away
segments.tr: ## 远方的第二次地震

segments.src: Hours after the Flores earthquake, a separate significant tremor struck near Sumatra, an island more than 2,000 kilometers to the west.
segments.tr: 弗洛雷斯地震几小时后，一场单独的显著地震袭击了位于西方超过2,000公里外的苏门答腊岛附近。

segments.src: While authorities have not linked the two events directly, the near-simultaneous disasters strained national resources already stretched thin by the Flores response, requiring BNPB to coordinate relief efforts across two regions at once.
segments.tr: 虽然当局没有直接关联这两起事件，但这些几乎同时发生的灾难给已经因弗洛雷斯应对而紧张的国家资源造成了压力，要求BNPB同时在两个地区协调救援工作。

segments.src: Seismologists note that such back-to-back events, while striking in their timing, are not unusual for Indonesia, which straddles the Pacific Ring of Fire — a horseshoe-shaped zone stretching around the Pacific Basin where the majority of the world's earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
segments.tr: 地震学家指出，这样的连续事件虽然时间上令人震惊，但对于位于太平洋火环的印度尼西亚来说并不罕见——太平洋火环是一个环绕太平洋盆地的马蹄形地带，世界上大多数地震和火山爆发都发生在这里。

segments.src: The archipelago sits at the junction of several tectonic plates, making seismic activity a near-constant feature of life for its more than 270 million residents.
segments.tr: 这个群岛位于几个构造板块的交界处，使地震活动成为其2.7亿多居民生活中的一个几乎不变的特征。

segments.src: ## Testing a Familiar System Under New Strain
segments.tr: ## 在新压力下测试熟悉的系统

segments.src: Indonesia has built one of the more experienced disaster-response frameworks in the world, shaped by decades of earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and the catastrophic 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
segments.tr: 印度尼西亚建立了世界上最有经验的应灾框架之一，由数十年的地震、火山爆发和2004年灾难性的印度洋海啸所塑造。

segments.src: Early-warning networks, community evacuation drills, and rapid-deployment rescue units have all been refined in the years since.
segments.tr: 自那以后的多年里，早期预警网络、社区疏散演习和快速部署救援单位都得到了完善。

segments.src: Even so, officials acknowledge that the combination of a high-magnitude quake, a prolonged aftershock sequence, and a second major event on the same day represents an unusually demanding scenario.
segments.tr: 即便如此，官员们承认高震级地震、持久的余震序列和同一天的第二次重大事件的结合代表了一个异常苛刻的情景。

segments.src: The government has mobilized military and volunteer personnel to support local first responders, while international aid organizations have begun coordinating with Indonesian authorities to assess additional needs.
segments.tr: 政府已动员军事和志愿人员支持当地的第一响应者，同时国际援助组织已开始与印度尼西亚当局协调以评估额外需求。

segments.src: Officials caution that damage assessments are still ongoing and that casualty and displacement figures may continue to rise as rescue teams reach areas that remain cut off.
segments.tr: 官员们警告称，损害评估仍在进行中，随着救援队到达仍然被切断的地区，伤亡和流离失所人数可能会继续上升。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: For now, the focus remains on the immediate humanitarian response: reopening roads, stabilizing damaged buildings, and ensuring displaced families have access to shelter and medical care as aftershocks continue to ripple through the region.
segments.tr: 目前，重点仍然是立即的人道主义响应：重新开放道路、稳定受损建筑物、并确保流离失所的家庭在余震继续影响该地区时获得庇护所和医疗护理。

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: 从长期来看，这场灾难有望在世界上地震最活跃的走廊之一重新开启关于建筑规范、早期预警基础设施和应急准备资金的讨论——提醒那些居住在太平洋火环沿岸的社区，复原力不是一次性的成就，而是一个持续的努力。

hi.title: एक दिन में दो बार कांपा समुद्र तट: इंडोनेशिया के फ्लोरेस द्वीप को तबाह करने वाले भूकंप के अंदर

segments.src: A powerful magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, killing more than 50 people and injuring hundreds more, according to national disaster officials.
segments.tr: एक शक्तिशाली 7.7 तीव्रता वाला भूकंप पूर्वी इंडोनेशिया के फ्लोरेस द्वीप के तट के पास आया, जिसमें 50 से अधिक लोग मारे गए और सैकड़ों अन्य घायल हुए, राष्ट्रीय आपदा अधिकारियों के अनुसार।

segments.src: The quake, one of the strongest to hit the region in years, was followed by more than 230 aftershocks and, hours later, a second major tremor that shook the island of Sumatra thousands of kilometers away — turning a single day into one of the most severe tests of Indonesia's emergency response systems in recent memory.
segments.tr: यह भूकंप, जो क्षेत्र को हिट करने वाला वर्षों में सबसे शक्तिशाली था, 230 से अधिक आफ्टरशॉक्स से पहले था और, कुछ घंटों बाद, एक दूसरा प्रमुख कंपन जिसने सुमात्रा द्वीप को हजारों किलोमीटर दूर झकझोरा — एक एकल दिन को इंडोनेशिया की आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रिया प्रणाली के सबसे गंभीर परीक्षणों में से एक में बदल दिया।

segments.src: ## A Sudden, Violent Shock
segments.tr: ## अचानक, हिंसक झटका

segments.src: The initial quake struck without warning, its epicenter located beneath the seabed near Flores, a mountainous island in the Nusa Tenggara region known for its volcanic terrain and small coastal communities.
segments.tr: प्रारंभिक भूकंप बिना चेतावनी के आया, इसका केंद्र फ्लोरेस के पास समुद्र तल के नीचे स्थित था, यह नुसा तेंगारा क्षेत्र में एक पहाड़ी द्वीप है जो अपनी ज्वालामुखी भूमि और छोटे तटीय समुदायों के लिए जाना जाता है।

segments.src: Indonesia's Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) issued a tsunami advisory in the immediate aftermath, prompting evacuations along low-lying shorelines before the warning was later downgraded.
segments.tr: इंडोनेशिया की मौसम संबंधी, जलवायु और भूभौतिकीय एजेंसी (BMKG) ने तुरंत बाद एक सुनामी चेतावनी जारी की, जिसमें कम-ऊंचाई वाली तटरेखा के साथ निकासी की प्रेरणा मिली इससे पहले कि चेतावनी को बाद में कम किया गया।

segments.src: The shaking was strong enough to collapse older masonry buildings, damage schools and health clinics, and trigger landslides that buried sections of the island's main coastal roads.
segments.tr: कांपन इतना मजबूत था कि पुरानी ईंट की इमारतों को ढहा दिया, स्कूलों और स्वास्थ्य क्लीनिकों को नुकसान पहुंचा, और भूस्खलन को ट्रिगर किया जो द्वीप की मुख्य तटीय सड़कों के हिस्सों को दबा गया।

segments.src: Officials with Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) reported that thousands of residents were displaced, many now sheltering in temporary camps, mosques, and community halls as search-and-rescue teams work to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: इंडोनेशिया की राष्ट्रीय आपदा प्रबंधन एजेंसी (BNPB) के अधिकारियों ने सूचित किया कि हजारों निवासी विस्थापित हुए, कई अब अस्थायी शिविरों, मस्जिदों, और सामुदायिक हॉलों में शरण ले रहे हैं क्योंकि खोज और बचाव दल अलग-थलग गांवों तक पहुंचने के लिए काम कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## Aftershocks Complicate the Response
segments.tr: ## आफ्टरशॉक्स प्रतिक्रिया को जटिल करते हैं

segments.src: What has made this disaster especially difficult to manage is the sheer volume of aftershocks that followed — more than 230 by some counts, according to seismic monitoring agencies.
segments.tr: जो इस आपदा को प्रबंधन के लिए विशेष रूप से कठिन बनाता है वह आफ्टरशॉक्स की विशाल मात्रा है जो सामने आई — कुछ गणनाओं के अनुसार 230 से अधिक, भूकंपीय निगरानी एजेंसियों के अनुसार।

segments.src: Each new tremor has slowed rescue efforts, forcing crews to repeatedly pause work on unstable structures and landslide-blocked routes out of concern for further collapses.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक नई कंपन ने बचाव प्रयासों को धीमा कर दिया है, दलों को बार-बार अस्थिर संरचनाओं पर काम को रोकने के लिए मजबूर किया और भूस्खलन-अवरुद्ध मार्गों पर, आगे के पतन की चिंता से।

segments.src: Emergency responders have relied on heavy equipment to clear debris from roads connecting Flores' interior communities to coastal hospitals, but mountainous terrain and damaged infrastructure have made some areas reachable only on foot or by helicopter.
segments.tr: आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रियाकारी फ्लोरेस के आंतरिक समुदायों को तटीय अस्पतालों से जोड़ने वाली सड़कों से मलबा साफ करने के लिए भारी उपकरण पर निर्भर हैं, लेकिन पहाड़ी भूभाग और क्षतिग्रस्त बुनियादी ढांचे ने कुछ क्षेत्रों को केवल पैदल या हेलीकॉप्टर द्वारा पहुंचने योग्य बनाया है।

segments.src: Local authorities say the priority remains locating survivors, restoring access to remote villages, and delivering clean water, food, and medical supplies to displaced families.
segments.tr: स्थानीय अधिकारी कहते हैं कि प्राथमिकता जीवित रहे लोगों को खोजना, दूरदराज के गांवों तक पहुंच बहाल करना, और विस्थापित परिवारों को स्वच्छ पानी, भोजन, और चिकित्सा आपूर्ति प्रदान करना है।

segments.src: ## A Second Quake, Far Away
segments.tr: ## दूर दूसरा भूकंप

segments.src: Hours after the Flores earthquake, a separate significant tremor struck near Sumatra, an island more than 2,000 kilometers to the west.
segments.tr: फ्लोरेस भूकंप के घंटों बाद, एक अलग महत्वपूर्ण कंपन सुमात्रा के पास आया, एक द्वीप जो पश्चिम की ओर 2,000 किलोमीटर से अधिक है।

segments.src: While authorities have not linked the two events directly, the near-simultaneous disasters strained national resources already stretched thin by the Flores response, requiring BNPB to coordinate relief efforts across two regions at once.
segments.tr: जबकि अधिकारियों ने दोनों घटनाओं को सीधे जोड़ा नहीं है, लगभग समवर्ती आपदाओं ने राष्ट्रीय संसाधनों को तनाव में डाल दिया जो पहले से ही फ्लोरेस प्रतिक्रिया से पतले खिंचे हुए थे, BNPB को दो क्षेत्रों में एक साथ राहत प्रयासों को समन्वित करने की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: Seismologists note that such back-to-back events, while striking in their timing, are not unusual for Indonesia, which straddles the Pacific Ring of Fire — a horseshoe-shaped zone stretching around the Pacific Basin where the majority of the world's earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
segments.tr: भूकंप विशेषज्ञ ध्यान दें कि इस तरह की लगातार घटनाएं, हालांकि उनके समय में चमकदार हैं, इंडोनेशिया के लिए असामान्य नहीं हैं, जो प्रशांत अग्नि वलय को समझता है — एक नाल के आकार का क्षेत्र जो प्रशांत बेसिन के चारों ओर फैला है जहां दुनिया के अधिकांश भूकंप और ज्वालामुखी विस्फोट होते हैं।

segments.src: The archipelago sits at the junction of several tectonic plates, making seismic activity a near-constant feature of life for its more than 270 million residents.
segments.tr: द्वीपसमूह कई टेक्टोनिक प्लेटों के जंक्शन पर बैठा है, जो इसके 270 मिलियन से अधिक निवासियों के लिए जीवन की एक लगभग निरंतर विशेषता बनाता है।

segments.src: ## Testing a Familiar System Under New Strain
segments.tr: ## नई दबाव के तहत एक परिचित प्रणाली का परीक्षण

segments.src: Indonesia has built one of the more experienced disaster-response frameworks in the world, shaped by decades of earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and the catastrophic 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
segments.tr: इंडोनेशिया ने दुनिया में अधिक अनुभवी आपदा-प्रतिक्रिया ढांचे में से एक का निर्माण किया है, जो दशकों के भूकंप, ज्वालामुखी विस्फोट, और विनाशकारी 2004 हिंद महासागर सुनामी द्वारा आकार दिया गया है।

segments.src: Early-warning networks, community evacuation drills, and rapid-deployment rescue units have all been refined in the years since.
segments.tr: प्रारंभिक-चेतावनी नेटवर्क, सामुदायिक निकासी ड्रिल, और तेजी से तैनाती बचाव इकाइयों को सभी के बाद से वर्षों में परिष्कृत किया गया है।

segments.src: Even so, officials acknowledge that the combination of a high-magnitude quake, a prolonged aftershock sequence, and a second major event on the same day represents an unusually demanding scenario.
segments.tr: फिर भी, अधिकारी स्वीकार करते हैं कि उच्च-परिमाण भूकंप, एक लंबे आफ्टरशॉक अनुक्रम, और एक ही दिन पर दूसरी प्रमुख घटना का संयोजन एक असामान्य रूप से मांग परिदृश्य का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

segments.src: The government has mobilized military and volunteer personnel to support local first responders, while international aid organizations have begun coordinating with Indonesian authorities to assess additional needs.
segments.tr: सरकार ने स्थानीय प्रथम प्रतिक्रियाकारी का समर्थन करने के लिए सैन्य और स्वयंसेवक कर्मियों को गतिशील किया है, जबकि अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहायता संगठनों ने अतिरिक्त जरूरतों का आकलन करने के लिए इंडोनेशियाई अधिकारियों के साथ समन्वय करना शुरू किया है।

segments.src: Officials caution that damage assessments are still ongoing and that casualty and displacement figures may continue to rise as rescue teams reach areas that remain cut off.
segments.tr: अधिकारी सावधान करते हैं कि क्षति मूल्यांकन अभी भी चल रहा है और हताहत और विस्थापन के आंकड़े बढ़ते रह सकते हैं क्योंकि बचाव दल उन क्षेत्रों तक पहुंचते हैं जो अलग रहते हैं।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## अगला क्या आता है

segments.src: For now, the focus remains on the immediate humanitarian response: reopening roads, stabilizing damaged buildings, and ensuring displaced families have access to shelter and medical care as aftershocks continue to ripple through the region.
segments.tr: अभी के लिए, ध्यान तत्काल मानवीय प्रतिक्रिया पर केंद्रित है: सड़कों को फिर से खोलना, क्षतिग्रस्त इमारतों को स्थिर करना, और विस्थापित परिवारों को आश्रय और चिकित्सा देखभाल तक पहुंच सुनिश्चित करना क्योंकि आफ्टरशॉक्स क्षेत्र के माध्यम से लहरें देते हैं।

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: दीर्घावधि में, आपदा को निर्माण कोड, प्रारंभिक-चेतावनी बुनियादी ढांचे, और तैयारी वित्त पोषण के चारों ओर चर्चा को नवीनीकृत करने की उम्मीद है ग्रह पर सबसे भूकंपीय रूप से सक्रिय गलियारों में से एक में — एक अनुस्मारक कि अग्नि वलय के साथ रहने वाले समुदायों के लिए, लचीलापन एक बार की उपलब्धि नहीं है बल्कि एक चल रहा प्रयास है।

es.title: Una costa se sacudió dos veces en un día: dentro del terremoto que devastó la isla de Flores de Indonesia

segments.src: A powerful magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, killing more than 50 people and injuring hundreds more, according to national disaster officials.
segments.tr: Un poderoso terremoto de magnitud 7,7 golpeó la costa de la isla de Flores en el este de Indonesia, matando a más de 50 personas e hiriendo a cientos más, según funcionarios nacionales de desastres.

segments.src: The quake, one of the strongest to hit the region in years, was followed by more than 230 aftershocks and, hours later, a second major tremor that shook the island of Sumatra thousands of kilometers away — turning a single day into one of the most severe tests of Indonesia's emergency response systems in recent memory.
segments.tr: El terremoto, uno de los más fuertes en golpear la región en años, fue seguido por más de 230 réplicas y, horas después, un segundo temblor importante que sacudió la isla de Sumatra a miles de kilómetros de distancia — convirtiendo un solo día en una de las pruebas más severas de los sistemas de respuesta a emergencias de Indonesia en la memoria reciente.

segments.src: ## A Sudden, Violent Shock
segments.tr: ## Un choque repentino y violento

segments.src: The initial quake struck without warning, its epicenter located beneath the seabed near Flores, a mountainous island in the Nusa Tenggara region known for its volcanic terrain and small coastal communities.
segments.tr: El terremoto inicial golpeó sin advertencia, su epicentro ubicado bajo el lecho marino cerca de Flores, una isla montañosa en la región de Nusa Tenggara conocida por su terreno volcánico y pequeñas comunidades costeras.

segments.src: Indonesia's Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) issued a tsunami advisory in the immediate aftermath, prompting evacuations along low-lying shorelines before the warning was later downgraded.
segments.tr: La Agencia Meteorológica, Climatológica y Geofísica de Indonesia (BMKG) emitió una advertencia de tsunami inmediatamente después, promoviendo evacuaciones a lo largo de las costas bajas antes de que la advertencia fuera posteriormente retirada.

segments.src: The shaking was strong enough to collapse older masonry buildings, damage schools and health clinics, and trigger landslides that buried sections of the island's main coastal roads.
segments.tr: El temblor fue lo suficientemente fuerte como para colapsar edificios de mampostería más antiguos, dañar escuelas y clínicas de salud, y desencadenar deslizamientos de tierra que enterraron secciones de las principales carreteras costeras de la isla.

segments.src: Officials with Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) reported that thousands of residents were displaced, many now sheltering in temporary camps, mosques, and community halls as search-and-rescue teams work to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Funcionarios de la Agencia Nacional de Gestión de Desastres de Indonesia (BNPB) reportaron que miles de residentes fueron desplazados, muchos ahora refugiándose en campamentos temporales, mezquitas y salones comunitarios mientras equipos de búsqueda y rescate trabajan para llegar a pueblos aislados.

segments.src: ## Aftershocks Complicate the Response
segments.tr: ## Las réplicas complican la respuesta

segments.src: What has made this disaster especially difficult to manage is the sheer volume of aftershocks that followed — more than 230 by some counts, according to seismic monitoring agencies.
segments.tr: Lo que ha hecho que este desastre sea especialmente difícil de manejar es el volumen puro de réplicas que siguieron — más de 230 según algunos recuentos, de acuerdo con agencias de monitoreo sísmico.

segments.src: Each new tremor has slowed rescue efforts, forcing crews to repeatedly pause work on unstable structures and landslide-blocked routes out of concern for further collapses.
segments.tr: Cada nuevo temblor ha ralentizado los esfuerzos de rescate, obligando a las cuadrillas a pausar repetidamente el trabajo en estructuras inestables y rutas bloqueadas por deslizamientos de tierra por preocupación por más colapsos.

segments.src: Emergency responders have relied on heavy equipment to clear debris from roads connecting Flores' interior communities to coastal hospitals, but mountainous terrain and damaged infrastructure have made some areas reachable only on foot or by helicopter.
segments.tr: Los respondedores de emergencia han confiado en equipos pesados para limpiar los escombros de las carreteras que conectan las comunidades interiores de Flores con hospitales costeros, pero el terreno montañoso e infraestructura dañada han hecho que algunas áreas sean accesibles solo a pie o en helicóptero.

segments.src: Local authorities say the priority remains locating survivors, restoring access to remote villages, and delivering clean water, food, and medical supplies to displaced families.
segments.tr: Las autoridades locales dicen que la prioridad sigue siendo localizar a los sobrevivientes, restaurar el acceso a pueblos remotos, y entregar agua limpia, alimentos y suministros médicos a familias desplazadas.

segments.src: ## A Second Quake, Far Away
segments.tr: ## Un segundo terremoto, lejos

segments.src: Hours after the Flores earthquake, a separate significant tremor struck near Sumatra, an island more than 2,000 kilometers to the west.
segments.tr: Horas después del terremoto de Flores, un temblor significativo separado golpeó cerca de Sumatra, una isla a más de 2.000 kilómetros al oeste.

segments.src: While authorities have not linked the two events directly, the near-simultaneous disasters strained national resources already stretched thin by the Flores response, requiring BNPB to coordinate relief efforts across two regions at once.
segments.tr: Aunque las autoridades no han vinculado directamente los dos eventos, los desastres casi simultáneos tensaron los recursos nacionales ya estirados por la respuesta de Flores, requiriendo que la BNPB coordine esfuerzos de alivio en dos regiones a la vez.

segments.src: Seismologists note that such back-to-back events, while striking in their timing, are not unusual for Indonesia, which straddles the Pacific Ring of Fire — a horseshoe-shaped zone stretching around the Pacific Basin where the majority of the world's earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
segments.tr: Los sismólogos señalan que tales eventos sucesivos, aunque sorprendentes en su sincronización, no son inusuales para Indonesia, que se encuentra a horcajadas sobre el Anillo de Fuego del Pacífico — una zona en forma de herradura que se extiende alrededor de la cuenca del Pacífico donde ocurre la mayoría de los terremotos y erupciones volcánicas del mundo.

segments.src: The archipelago sits at the junction of several tectonic plates, making seismic activity a near-constant feature of life for its more than 270 million residents.
segments.tr: El archipiélago se encuentra en la confluencia de varias placas tectónicas, haciendo que la actividad sísmica sea una característica casi constante de la vida para sus más de 270 millones de residentes.

segments.src: ## Testing a Familiar System Under New Strain
segments.tr: ## Probando un sistema familiar bajo nueva presión

segments.src: Indonesia has built one of the more experienced disaster-response frameworks in the world, shaped by decades of earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and the catastrophic 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
segments.tr: Indonesia ha construido uno de los marcos de respuesta a desastres más experimentados del mundo, moldeado por décadas de terremotos, erupciones volcánicas, y el catastrófico tsunami del Océano Índico de 2004.

segments.src: Early-warning networks, community evacuation drills, and rapid-deployment rescue units have all been refined in the years since.
segments.tr: Las redes de alerta temprana, simulacros de evacuación comunitaria, y unidades de rescate de despliegue rápido han sido refinadas en los años desde entonces.

segments.src: Even so, officials acknowledge that the combination of a high-magnitude quake, a prolonged aftershock sequence, and a second major event on the same day represents an unusually demanding scenario.
segments.tr: Aun así, los funcionarios reconocen que la combinación de un terremoto de alta magnitud, una secuencia prolongada de réplicas, y un segundo evento importante en el mismo día representa un escenario inusualmente exigente.

segments.src: The government has mobilized military and volunteer personnel to support local first responders, while international aid organizations have begun coordinating with Indonesian authorities to assess additional needs.
segments.tr: El gobierno ha movilizado personal militar y voluntario para apoyar a los primeros respondedores locales, mientras que organizaciones de ayuda internacional han comenzado a coordinar con las autoridades indonesias para evaluar necesidades adicionales.

segments.src: Officials caution that damage assessments are still ongoing and that casualty and displacement figures may continue to rise as rescue teams reach areas that remain cut off.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios advierten que las evaluaciones de daños aún están en curso y que las cifras de bajas y desplazamientos pueden continuar aumentando a medida que los equipos de rescate lleguen a áreas que permanecen aisladas.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué viene a continuación

segments.src: For now, the focus remains on the immediate humanitarian response: reopening roads, stabilizing damaged buildings, and ensuring displaced families have access to shelter and medical care as aftershocks continue to ripple through the region.
segments.tr: Por ahora, el enfoque sigue siendo la respuesta humanitaria inmediata: reapertura de carreteras, estabilización de edificios dañados, y garantizar que las familias desplazadas tengan acceso a refugio y atención médica mientras las réplicas continúan propagándose por la región.

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: A largo plazo, se espera que el desastre renueve la discusión en torno a códigos de construcción, infraestructura de alerta temprana, y financiamiento de preparación en uno de los corredores sísmicamente más activos del planeta — un recordatorio de que para las comunidades que viven a lo largo del Anillo de Fuego, la resiliencia no es un logro único sino un esfuerzo continuo.

ar.title: ساحل هز مرتين في يوم واحد: حول الزلزال الذي دمر جزيرة فلوريس بإندونيسيا

segments.src: A powerful magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, killing more than 50 people and injuring hundreds more, according to national disaster officials.
segments.tr: ضرب زلزال قوي بقوة 7.7 درجات قبالة ساحل جزيرة فلوريس في شرق إندونيسيا، مما أسفر عن مقتل أكثر من 50 شخصاً وإصابة مئات آخرين، وفقاً لمسؤولي الكوارث الوطنيين.

segments.src: The quake, one of the strongest to hit the region in years, was followed by more than 230 aftershocks and, hours later, a second major tremor that shook the island of Sumatra thousands of kilometers away — turning a single day into one of the most severe tests of Indonesia's emergency response systems in recent memory.
segments.tr: الزلزال، وهو أحد أقوى الزلازل التي ضربت المنطقة منذ سنوات، تبعه أكثر من 230 هزة ارتدادية وبعد ساعات، هزة ثانية كبرى هزت جزيرة سومطرة على بعد آلاف الكيلومترات - مما حول يوماً واحداً إلى أحد أصعب الاختبارات لأنظمة الاستجابة للطوارئ في إندونيسيا في الذاكرة الحديثة.

segments.src: ## A Sudden, Violent Shock
segments.tr: ## صدمة مفاجئة وعنيفة

segments.src: The initial quake struck without warning, its epicenter located beneath the seabed near Flores, a mountainous island in the Nusa Tenggara region known for its volcanic terrain and small coastal communities.
segments.tr: ضرب الزلزال الأولي بدون تحذير، مع تمركز مركزه تحت قاع البحر بالقرب من فلوريس، جزيرة جبلية في منطقة نوسا تينجارا معروفة بتضاريسها البركانية والمجتمعات الساحلية الصغيرة.

segments.src: Indonesia's Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) issued a tsunami advisory in the immediate aftermath, prompting evacuations along low-lying shorelines before the warning was later downgraded.
segments.tr: أصدرت وكالة إندونيسيا الأرصاد الجوية والمناخية والجيوفيزيائية (BMKG) تنبيهاً من تسونامي في أعقاب الحادث مباشرة، مما أدى إلى عمليات إجلاء على طول السواحل المنخفضة قبل أن يتم تخفيف التنبيه لاحقاً.

segments.src: The shaking was strong enough to collapse older masonry buildings, damage schools and health clinics, and trigger landslides that buried sections of the island's main coastal roads.
segments.tr: كان الاهتزاز قوياً بما يكفي لانهيار المباني القديمة المبنية بالحجر، وإلحاق الضرر بالمدارس والعيادات الصحية، وإطلاق الانهيارات الأرضية التي دفنت أقسام الطرق الساحلية الرئيسية للجزيرة.

segments.src: Officials with Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) reported that thousands of residents were displaced, many now sheltering in temporary camps, mosques, and community halls as search-and-rescue teams work to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: أفاد مسؤولو وكالة إدارة الكوارث الوطنية بإندونيسيا (BNPB) بأن آلاف السكان نزحوا، وكثيرون منهم يأوون الآن إلى المخيمات المؤقتة والمساجد وقاعات المجتمع بينما تعمل فرق البحث والإنقاذ على الوصول إلى القرى المعزولة.

segments.src: ## Aftershocks Complicate the Response
segments.tr: ## الهزات الارتدادية تعقد الاستجابة

segments.src: What has made this disaster especially difficult to manage is the sheer volume of aftershocks that followed — more than 230 by some counts, according to seismic monitoring agencies.
segments.tr: ما جعل هذه الكارثة صعبة الإدارة بشكل خاص هو الحجم الهائل من الهزات الارتدادية التي تبعتها - أكثر من 230 وفقاً لبعض الحسابات، وفقاً لوكالات المراقبة الزلزالية.

segments.src: Each new tremor has slowed rescue efforts, forcing crews to repeatedly pause work on unstable structures and landslide-blocked routes out of concern for further collapses.
segments.tr: أبطأت كل هزة جديدة جهود الإنقاذ، مما أجبر الطواقم على إيقاف العمل بشكل متكرر على الهياكل غير المستقرة والطرق المحجوبة بالانهيارات الأرضية خوفاً من انهيارات أخرى.

segments.src: Emergency responders have relied on heavy equipment to clear debris from roads connecting Flores' interior communities to coastal hospitals, but mountainous terrain and damaged infrastructure have made some areas reachable only on foot or by helicopter.
segments.tr: اعتمد المستجيبون للطوارئ على الآليات الثقيلة لإزالة الحطام من الطرق التي تربط المجتمعات الداخلية بفلوريس بالمستشفيات الساحلية، لكن التضاريس الجبلية والبنية التحتية التالفة جعلت بعض المناطق يمكن الوصول إليها فقط سيراً على الأقدام أو بالمروحية.

segments.src: Local authorities say the priority remains locating survivors, restoring access to remote villages, and delivering clean water, food, and medical supplies to displaced families.
segments.tr: تقول السلطات المحلية أن الأولوية تبقى تحديد موقع الناجين واستعادة الوصول إلى القرى النائية وتوصيل المياه النظيفة والغذاء والإمدادات الطبية للعائلات النازحة.

segments.src: ## A Second Quake, Far Away
segments.tr: ## زلزال ثانٍ، بعيداً عن هنا

segments.src: Hours after the Flores earthquake, a separate significant tremor struck near Sumatra, an island more than 2,000 kilometers to the west.
segments.tr: بعد ساعات من زلزال فلوريس، ضربت هزة كبيرة منفصلة بالقرب من سومطرة، جزيرة على بعد أكثر من 2,000 كيلومتر إلى الغرب.

segments.src: While authorities have not linked the two events directly, the near-simultaneous disasters strained national resources already stretched thin by the Flores response, requiring BNPB to coordinate relief efforts across two regions at once.
segments.tr: بينما لم تربط السلطات بين الحدثين بشكل مباشر، أرهقت الكوارث المتزامنة تقريباً الموارد الوطنية المرهقة بالفعل من استجابة فلوريس، مما اضطر BNPB لتنسيق جهود الإغاثة عبر منطقتين في نفس الوقت.

segments.src: Seismologists note that such back-to-back events, while striking in their timing, are not unusual for Indonesia, which straddles the Pacific Ring of Fire — a horseshoe-shaped zone stretching around the Pacific Basin where the majority of the world's earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
segments.tr: يلاحظ الزلزاليون أن مثل هذه الأحداث المتعاقبة، على الرغم من أنها مثيرة في توقيتها، ليست غير عادية بالنسبة لإندونيسيا، التي تقع على حلقة النار في المحيط الهادئ - منطقة على شكل حدوة حصان تمتد حول حوض المحيط الهادئ حيث يحدث معظم زلازل العالم والانفجارات البركانية.

segments.src: The archipelago sits at the junction of several tectonic plates, making seismic activity a near-constant feature of life for its more than 270 million residents.
segments.tr: يقع الأرخبيل على تقاطع عدة صفائح تكتونية، مما يجعل النشاط الزلزالي سمة شبه ثابتة في الحياة لأكثر من 270 مليون ساكن.

segments.src: ## Testing a Familiar System Under New Strain
segments.tr: ## اختبار نظام معروف تحت ضغط جديد

segments.src: Indonesia has built one of the more experienced disaster-response frameworks in the world, shaped by decades of earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and the catastrophic 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
segments.tr: بنت إندونيسيا أحد أكثر أطر الاستجابة للكوارث خبرة في العالم، شكلتها عقود من الزلازل والانفجارات البركانية وكارثة تسونامي المحيط الهندي المدمرة عام 2004.

segments.src: Early-warning networks, community evacuation drills, and rapid-deployment rescue units have all been refined in the years since.
segments.tr: تم تحسين شبكات الإنذار المبكر وتدريبات إجلاء المجتمع ووحدات الإنقاذ سريعة النشر جميعاً في السنوات التالية.

segments.src: Even so, officials acknowledge that the combination of a high-magnitude quake, a prolonged aftershock sequence, and a second major event on the same day represents an unusually demanding scenario.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، يقر المسؤولون بأن مزيج الزلزال عالي الشدة وسلسلة الهزات الارتدادية المطولة وحدث رئيسي ثانٍ في نفس اليوم يمثل سيناريو مرهقاً بشكل غير عادي.

segments.src: The government has mobilized military and volunteer personnel to support local first responders, while international aid organizations have begun coordinating with Indonesian authorities to assess additional needs.
segments.tr: قامت الحكومة بتحشيد الأفراد العسكريين والمتطوعين لدعم المستجيبين الأوليين المحليين، بينما بدأت منظمات الإغاثة الدولية التنسيق مع السلطات الإندونيسية لتقييم الاحتياجات الإضافية.

segments.src: Officials caution that damage assessments are still ongoing and that casualty and displacement figures may continue to rise as rescue teams reach areas that remain cut off.
segments.tr: يحذر المسؤولون من أن تقييمات الأضرار لا تزال جارية وأن أرقام الإصابات والنزوح قد تستمر في الارتفاع مع وصول فرق الإنقاذ إلى مناطق تبقى معزولة.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ما يأتي بعد ذلك

segments.src: For now, the focus remains on the immediate humanitarian response: reopening roads, stabilizing damaged buildings, and ensuring displaced families have access to shelter and medical care as aftershocks continue to ripple through the region.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يبقى التركيز على الاستجابة الإنسانية الفورية: إعادة فتح الطرق وتثبيت المباني التالفة والتأكد من أن العائلات النازحة لديها وصول إلى المأوى والرعاية الطبية مع استمرار الهزات الارتدادية في التموج عبر المنطقة.

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: على المدى الطويل، من المتوقع أن تجدد الكارثة النقاش حول قوانين البناء والبنية التحتية للإنذار المبكر وتمويل الاستعداد في أحد أكثر الممرات النشطة زلزالياً على الكوكب - تذكير بأنه بالنسبة للمجتمعات التي تعيش على طول حلقة النار، المرونة ليست إنجازاً لمرة واحدة بل جهداً مستمراً.

fr.title: Un littoral secoué deux fois en un jour : à l'intérieur du tremblement de terre qui a dévasté l'île de Flores en Indonésie

segments.src: A powerful magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, killing more than 50 people and injuring hundreds more, according to national disaster officials.
segments.tr: Un puissant tremblement de terre de magnitude 7,7 a frappé au large des côtes de l'île de Flores dans l'est de l'Indonésie, tuant plus de 50 personnes et en blessant des centaines d'autres, selon les autorités nationales de gestion des catastrophes.

segments.src: The quake, one of the strongest to hit the region in years, was followed by more than 230 aftershocks and, hours later, a second major tremor that shook the island of Sumatra thousands of kilometers away — turning a single day into one of the most severe tests of Indonesia's emergency response systems in recent memory.
segments.tr: Le tremblement de terre, l'un des plus forts à frapper la région ces dernières années, a été suivi de plus de 230 répliques sismiques et, quelques heures plus tard, d'une deuxième secousse majeure qui a secoué l'île de Sumatra à des milliers de kilomètres de distance — transformant une seule journée en l'un des tests les plus graves des systèmes d'intervention d'urgence de l'Indonésie dans les mémoires récentes.

segments.src: ## A Sudden, Violent Shock
segments.tr: ## Une secousse soudaine et violente

segments.src: The initial quake struck without warning, its epicenter located beneath the seabed near Flores, a mountainous island in the Nusa Tenggara region known for its volcanic terrain and small coastal communities.
segments.tr: Le tremblement de terre initial a frappé sans avertissement, son épicentre localisé sous le lit marin près de Flores, une île montagneuse de la région de Nusa Tenggara connue pour son terrain volcanique et ses petites communautés côtières.

segments.src: Indonesia's Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) issued a tsunami advisory in the immediate aftermath, prompting evacuations along low-lying shorelines before the warning was later downgraded.
segments.tr: L'Agence météorologique, climatologique et géophysique de l'Indonésie (BMKG) a émis un avertissement de tsunami immédiatement après, incitant les évacuations le long des rivages bas avant que l'avertissement ne soit ultérieurement rétrogradé.

segments.src: The shaking was strong enough to collapse older masonry buildings, damage schools and health clinics, and trigger landslides that buried sections of the island's main coastal roads.
segments.tr: La secousse était suffisamment forte pour effondrer les bâtiments en maçonnerie plus anciens, endommager les écoles et les cliniques de santé, et déclencher des glissements de terrain qui ont enseveli des sections des principales routes côtières de l'île.

segments.src: Officials with Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) reported that thousands of residents were displaced, many now sheltering in temporary camps, mosques, and community halls as search-and-rescue teams work to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Les autorités de l'Agence nationale de gestion des catastrophes de l'Indonésie (BNPB) ont signalé que des milliers de résidents ont été déplacés, beaucoup maintenant se réfugiant dans des camps temporaires, des mosquées et des salles communautaires alors que les équipes de recherche et de sauvetage travaillent pour atteindre les villages isolés.

segments.src: ## Aftershocks Complicate the Response
segments.tr: ## Les répliques sismiques compliquent la réaction

segments.src: What has made this disaster especially difficult to manage is the sheer volume of aftershocks that followed — more than 230 by some counts, according to seismic monitoring agencies.
segments.tr: Ce qui a rendu cette catastrophe particulièrement difficile à gérer est le volume considérable de répliques sismiques qui ont suivi — plus de 230 selon certains comptes, selon les agences de surveillance sismique.

segments.src: Each new tremor has slowed rescue efforts, forcing crews to repeatedly pause work on unstable structures and landslide-blocked routes out of concern for further collapses.
segments.tr: Chaque nouvelle secousse a ralenti les efforts de sauvetage, forçant les équipes à arrêter à plusieurs reprises les travaux sur les structures instables et les routes bloquées par les glissements de terrain par crainte d'autres effondrements.

segments.src: Emergency responders have relied on heavy equipment to clear debris from roads connecting Flores' interior communities to coastal hospitals, but mountainous terrain and damaged infrastructure have made some areas reachable only on foot or by helicopter.
segments.tr: Les intervenants d'urgence se sont appuyés sur des équipements lourds pour dégager les débris des routes reliant les communautés intérieures de Flores aux hôpitaux côtiers, mais le terrain montagneux et les infrastructures endommagées ont rendu certaines zones accessibles uniquement à pied ou en hélicoptère.

segments.src: Local authorities say the priority remains locating survivors, restoring access to remote villages, and delivering clean water, food, and medical supplies to displaced families.
segments.tr: Les autorités locales affirment que la priorité reste la localisation des survivants, la restauration de l'accès aux villages éloignés et la livraison d'eau propre, de nourriture et de fournitures médicales aux familles déplacées.

segments.src: ## A Second Quake, Far Away
segments.tr: ## Un deuxième tremblement de terre, loin d'ici

segments.src: Hours after the Flores earthquake, a separate significant tremor struck near Sumatra, an island more than 2,000 kilometers to the west.
segments.tr: Des heures après le tremblement de terre de Flores, une secousse importante distincte a frappé près de Sumatra, une île à plus de 2 000 kilomètres à l'ouest.

segments.src: While authorities have not linked the two events directly, the near-simultaneous disasters strained national resources already stretched thin by the Flores response, requiring BNPB to coordinate relief efforts across two regions at once.
segments.tr: Bien que les autorités n'aient pas relié directement les deux événements, les catastrophes quasi-simultanées ont mis à l'épreuve les ressources nationales déjà étirées par la réaction à Flores, obligeant la BNPB à coordonner les efforts de secours dans deux régions à la fois.

segments.src: Seismologists note that such back-to-back events, while striking in their timing, are not unusual for Indonesia, which straddles the Pacific Ring of Fire — a horseshoe-shaped zone stretching around the Pacific Basin where the majority of the world's earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
segments.tr: Les sismologues notent que de tels événements successifs, bien que frappants dans leur chronologie, ne sont pas inhabituels pour l'Indonésie, qui chevauche la Ceinture de feu du Pacifique — une zone en forme de fer à cheval s'étendant autour du bassin du Pacifique où la majorité des tremblements de terre et des éruptions volcaniques du monde se produisent.

segments.src: The archipelago sits at the junction of several tectonic plates, making seismic activity a near-constant feature of life for its more than 270 million residents.
segments.tr: L'archipel se situe à la jonction de plusieurs plaques tectoniques, ce qui rend l'activité sismique une caractéristique quasi-constante de la vie pour ses plus de 270 millions d'habitants.

segments.src: ## Testing a Familiar System Under New Strain
segments.tr: ## Tester un système familier sous une nouvelle tension

segments.src: Indonesia has built one of the more experienced disaster-response frameworks in the world, shaped by decades of earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and the catastrophic 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
segments.tr: L'Indonésie a construit l'un des cadres de réaction aux catastrophes les plus expérimentés au monde, façonné par des décennies de tremblements de terre, d'éruptions volcaniques et du tsunami catastrophique de l'océan Indien de 2004.

segments.src: Early-warning networks, community evacuation drills, and rapid-deployment rescue units have all been refined in the years since.
segments.tr: Les réseaux d'alerte précoce, les exercices d'évacuation communautaire et les unités de sauvetage à déploiement rapide ont tous été affinés au cours des années qui ont suivi.

segments.src: Even so, officials acknowledge that the combination of a high-magnitude quake, a prolonged aftershock sequence, and a second major event on the same day represents an unusually demanding scenario.
segments.tr: Néanmoins, les autorités reconnaissent que la combinaison d'un tremblement de terre de magnitude élevée, d'une séquence prolongée de répliques sismiques et d'un deuxième événement majeur le même jour représente un scénario inhabituellement exigeant.

segments.src: The government has mobilized military and volunteer personnel to support local first responders, while international aid organizations have begun coordinating with Indonesian authorities to assess additional needs.
segments.tr: Le gouvernement a mobilisé le personnel militaire et bénévole pour soutenir les premiers intervenants locaux, tandis que les organisations d'aide internationales ont commencé à coordonner avec les autorités indonésiennes pour évaluer les besoins supplémentaires.

segments.src: Officials caution that damage assessments are still ongoing and that casualty and displacement figures may continue to rise as rescue teams reach areas that remain cut off.
segments.tr: Les autorités avertissent que les évaluations des dégâts sont toujours en cours et que les chiffres des pertes et des déplacements peuvent continuer à augmenter à mesure que les équipes de sauvetage atteignent les zones qui restent coupées.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qu'en est-il ensuite

segments.src: For now, the focus remains on the immediate humanitarian response: reopening roads, stabilizing damaged buildings, and ensuring displaced families have access to shelter and medical care as aftershocks continue to ripple through the region.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, l'accent reste sur la réaction humanitaire immédiate : la réouverture des routes, la stabilisation des bâtiments endommagés et la garantie que les familles déplacées ont accès aux refuges et aux soins médicaux alors que les répliques sismiques continuent à se propager dans la région.

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: À plus long terme, la catastrophe devrait raviver la discussion autour des codes du bâtiment, de l'infrastructure d'alerte précoce et du financement de la préparation dans l'un des corridors les plus sismiquement actifs de la planète — un rappel que pour les communautés vivant le long de la Ceinture de feu, la résilience n'est pas une réussite ponctuelle mais un effort continu.
