segments.tr: A Agência Meteorológica, Climatológica e Geofísica da Indonésia (BMKG) emitiu um aviso de tsunami logo após o impacto, provocando evacuações ao longo de costas baixas antes do aviso ser posteriormente reduzido.

segments.src: The shaking was strong enough to collapse older masonry buildings, damage schools and health clinics, and trigger landslides that buried sections of the island's main coastal roads.
segments.tr: O tremor foi forte o suficiente para colapsar edifícios mais antigos de alvenaria, danificar escolas e clínicas de saúde, e desencadear deslizamentos de terra que enterraram seções das principais estradas costeiras da ilha.

segments.src: Officials with Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) reported that thousands of residents were displaced, many now sheltering in temporary camps, mosques, and community halls as search-and-rescue teams work to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Autoridades da Agência Nacional de Gerenciamento de Desastres da Indonésia (BNPB) informaram que milhares de residentes foram deslocados, muitos agora abrigados em acampamentos temporários, mesquitas e salões comunitários enquanto equipes de busca e resgate trabalham para alcançar aldeias isoladas.

segments.src: ## Aftershocks Complicate the Response
segments.tr: ## As Réplicas Complicam a Resposta

segments.src: What has made this disaster especially difficult to manage is the sheer volume of aftershocks that followed — more than 230 by some counts, according to seismic monitoring agencies.
segments.tr: O que tornou esse desastre especialmente difícil de gerenciar é o puro volume de réplicas que se seguiram — mais de 230 por algumas contagens, de acordo com agências de monitoramento sísmico.

segments.src: Each new tremor has slowed rescue efforts, forcing crews to repeatedly pause work on unstable structures and landslide-blocked routes out of concern for further collapses.
segments.tr: Cada novo tremor retardou os esforços de resgate, forçando as equipes a pausar repetidamente o trabalho em estruturas instáveis e rotas bloqueadas por deslizamentos de terra por preocupação com mais desabamentos.

segments.src: Emergency responders have relied on heavy equipment to clear debris from roads connecting Flores' interior communities to coastal hospitals, but mountainous terrain and damaged infrastructure have made some areas reachable only on foot or by helicopter.
segments.tr: Os socorristas dependeram de equipamentos pesados para limpar detritos das estradas que conectam comunidades do interior de Flores aos hospitais costeiros, mas o terreno montanhoso e a infraestrutura danificada tornaram algumas áreas acessíveis apenas a pé ou de helicóptero.

segments.src: Local authorities say the priority remains locating survivors, restoring access to remote villages, and delivering clean water, food, and medical supplies to displaced families.
segments.tr: As autoridades locais dizem que a prioridade continua sendo localizar sobreviventes, restaurar o acesso a aldeias remotas e entregar água potável, comida e suprimentos médicos às famílias deslocadas.

segments.src: ## A Second Quake, Far Away
segments.tr: ## Um Segundo Terremoto, Longe

segments.src: Hours after the Flores earthquake, a separate significant tremor struck near Sumatra, an island more than 2,000 kilometers to the west.
segments.tr: Horas após o terremoto de Flores, um tremor significativo separado atingiu perto de Sumatra, uma ilha a mais de 2.000 quilômetros a oeste.

segments.src: While authorities have not linked the two events directly, the near-simultaneous disasters strained national resources already stretched thin by the Flores response, requiring BNPB to coordinate relief efforts across two regions at once.
segments.tr: Embora as autoridades não tenham vinculado os dois eventos diretamente, os desastres quase simultâneos sobrecarregaram recursos nacionais já esticados pela resposta a Flores, exigindo que a BNPB coordenasse os esforços de alívio em duas regiões ao mesmo tempo.

segments.src: Seismologists note that such back-to-back events, while striking in their timing, are not unusual for Indonesia, which straddles the Pacific Ring of Fire — a horseshoe-shaped zone stretching around the Pacific Basin where the majority of the world's earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
segments.tr: Os sismólogos observam que tais eventos consecutivos, embora surpreendentes em seu cronograma, não são incomuns para a Indonésia, que fica no Anel de Fogo do Pacífico — uma zona em forma de ferradura que se estende ao redor da Bacia do Pacífico onde ocorrem a maioria dos terremotos e erupções vulcânicas do mundo.

segments.src: The archipelago sits at the junction of several tectonic plates, making seismic activity a near-constant feature of life for its more than 270 million residents.
segments.tr: O arquipélago fica na junção de várias placas tectônicas, tornando a atividade sísmica uma característica quase constante da vida para seus mais de 270 milhões de residentes.

segments.src: ## Testing a Familiar System Under New Strain
segments.tr: ## Testando um Sistema Familiar Sob Novo Estresse

segments.src: Indonesia has built one of the more experienced disaster-response frameworks in the world, shaped by decades of earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and the catastrophic 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
segments.tr: A Indonésia construiu um dos marcos de resposta a desastres mais experientes do mundo, moldado por décadas de terremotos, erupções vulcânicas e o tsunami catastrófico do Oceano Índico de 2004.

segments.src: Early-warning networks, community evacuation drills, and rapid-deployment rescue units have all been refined in the years since.
segments.tr: Redes de alerta prévio, simulados de evacuação comunitária e unidades de resgate de implantação rápida foram todos refinados nos anos desde então.

segments.src: Even so, officials acknowledge that the combination of a high-magnitude quake, a prolonged aftershock sequence, and a second major event on the same day represents an unusually demanding scenario.
segments.tr: Mesmo assim, as autoridades reconhecem que a combinação de um terremoto de alta magnitude, uma sequência prolongada de réplicas e um segundo evento importante no mesmo dia representa um cenário incomumente exigente.

segments.src: The government has mobilized military and volunteer personnel to support local first responders, while international aid organizations have begun coordinating with Indonesian authorities to assess additional needs.
segments.tr: O governo mobilizou pessoal militar e voluntário para apoiar socorristas locais, enquanto organizações internacionais de ajuda começaram a coordenar com autoridades indonésias para avaliar necessidades adicionais.

segments.src: Officials caution that damage assessments are still ongoing and that casualty and displacement figures may continue to rise as rescue teams reach areas that remain cut off.
segments.tr: Os autoridades alertam que as avaliações de danos ainda estão em andamento e que os números de vítimas e deslocamentos podem continuar a aumentar à medida que as equipes de resgate chegam a áreas que permanecem isoladas.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Vem a Seguir

segments.src: For now, the focus remains on the immediate humanitarian response: reopening roads, stabilizing damaged buildings, and ensuring displaced families have access to shelter and medical care as aftershocks continue to ripple through the region.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, o foco continua na resposta humanitária imediata: reabertura de estradas, estabilização de edifícios danificados e garantia de que as famílias deslocadas tenham acesso a abrigo e cuidados médicos enquanto as réplicas continuam a se propagar pela região.

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: A longo prazo, espera-se que o desastre renove a discussão sobre códigos de construção, infraestrutura de alerta prévio e financiamento de preparação em um dos corredores mais sísmicos ativos do planeta — um lembrete de que para comunidades que vivem ao longo do Anel de Fogo, a resiliência não é uma conquista única, mas um esforço contínuo.

in.title: Sebuah Garis Pantai Terguncang Dua Kali dalam Satu Hari: Di Dalam Gempa Bumi yang Merusak Pulau Flores Indonesia

segments.src: A powerful magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, killing more than 50 people and injuring hundreds more, according to national disaster officials.
segments.tr: Gempa bumi berkekuatan 7,7 yang dahsyat menimpa lepas pantai Pulau Flores di Indonesia timur, menewaskan lebih dari 50 orang dan melukai ratusan orang lainnya, menurut para pejabat penanggulangan bencana nasional.

segments.src: The quake, one of the strongest to hit the region in years, was followed by more than 230 aftershocks and, hours later, a second major tremor that shook the island of Sumatra thousands of kilometers away — turning a single day into one of the most severe tests of Indonesia's emergency response systems in recent memory.
segments.tr: Gempa bumi tersebut, salah satu yang terkuat menimpa wilayah dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, diikuti oleh lebih dari 230 gempa susulan dan, beberapa jam kemudian, sebuah gempa utama kedua yang mengguncang pulau Sumatra ribuan kilometer jauh — mengubah satu hari menjadi salah satu uji coba paling berat terhadap sistem respons darurat Indonesia dalam ingatan terakhir.

segments.src: ## A Sudden, Violent Shock
segments.tr: ## Guncangan Tiba-tiba yang Dahsyat

segments.src: The initial quake struck without warning, its epicenter located beneath the seabed near Flores, a mountainous island in the Nusa Tenggara region known for its volcanic terrain and small coastal communities.
segments.tr: Gempa awal menimpa tanpa peringatan, episenternya terletak di bawah dasar laut dekat Flores, sebuah pulau bergunung-gunung di wilayah Nusa Tenggara yang dikenal karena medan vulkaniknya dan komunitas pesisir kecilnya.

segments.src: Indonesia's Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) issued a tsunami advisory in the immediate aftermath, prompting evacuations along low-lying shorelines before the warning was later downgraded.
segments.tr: Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi dan Geofisika Indonesia (BMKG) mengeluarkan peringatan tsunami segera setelah kejadian, mendorong evakuasi di sepanjang garis pantai yang rendah sebelum peringatan tersebut kemudian diturunkan.

segments.src: The shaking was strong enough to collapse older masonry buildings, damage schools and health clinics, and trigger landslides that buried sections of the island's main coastal roads.
segments.tr: Guncangan tersebut cukup kuat untuk meruntuhkan bangunan batu bata tua, merusak sekolah dan klinik kesehatan, dan memicu tanah longsor yang menimbun bagian-bagian jalan pesisir utama pulau.

segments.src: Officials with Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) reported that thousands of residents were displaced, many now sheltering in temporary camps, mosques, and community halls as search-and-rescue teams work to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Para pejabat dari Badan Nasional Penanggulangan Bencana Indonesia (BNPB) melaporkan bahwa ribuan penduduk kehilangan tempat tinggal, banyak yang sekarang berlindung di kamp-kamp sementara, masjid, dan aula komunitas sementara tim pencarian dan penyelamatan bekerja untuk menjangkau desa-desa terpencil.

segments.src: ## Aftershocks Complicate the Response
segments.tr: ## Gempa Susulan Memperumit Respons

segments.src: What has made this disaster especially difficult to manage is the sheer volume of aftershocks that followed — more than 230 by some counts, according to seismic monitoring agencies.
segments.tr: Apa yang membuat bencana ini khususnya sulit dikelola adalah jumlah besar gempa susulan yang mengikuti — lebih dari 230 menurut beberapa laporan, menurut lembaga pemantauan seismik.

segments.src: Each new tremor has slowed rescue efforts, forcing crews to repeatedly pause work on unstable structures and landslide-blocked routes out of concern for further collapses.
segments.tr: Setiap gempa baru telah memperlambat upaya penyelamatan, memaksa tim untuk berulang kali menghentikan pekerjaan pada struktur yang tidak stabil dan rute yang diblokir oleh tanah longsor karena kekhawatiran tentang keruntuhan lebih lanjut.

segments.src: Emergency responders have relied on heavy equipment to clear debris from roads connecting Flores' interior communities to coastal hospitals, but mountainous terrain and damaged infrastructure have made some areas reachable only on foot or by helicopter.
segments.tr: Para responden darurat telah mengandalkan peralatan berat untuk membersihkan puing-puing dari jalan yang menghubungkan komunitas interior Flores ke rumah sakit pesisir, tetapi medan bergunung-gunung dan infrastruktur yang rusak telah membuat beberapa area hanya dapat dijangkau dengan berjalan kaki atau helikopter.

segments.src: Local authorities say the priority remains locating survivors, restoring access to remote villages, and delivering clean water, food, and medical supplies to displaced families.
segments.tr: Para otoritas lokal mengatakan prioritasnya tetap menemukan para penyintas, memulihkan akses ke desa-desa terpencil, dan memberikan air bersih, makanan, dan perlengkapan medis kepada keluarga-keluarga yang kehilangan tempat tinggal.

segments.src: ## A Second Quake, Far Away
segments.tr: ## Gempa Kedua, Jauh di Sana

segments.src: Hours after the Flores earthquake, a separate significant tremor struck near Sumatra, an island more than 2,000 kilometers to the west.
segments.tr: Beberapa jam setelah gempa bumi Flores, sebuah tremor penting yang terpisah menimpa dekat Sumatra, sebuah pulau lebih dari 2.000 kilometer ke barat.

segments.src: While authorities have not linked the two events directly, the near-simultaneous disasters strained national resources already stretched thin by the Flores response, requiring BNPB to coordinate relief efforts across two regions at once.
segments.tr: Meskipun para otoritas belum menghubungkan kedua peristiwa tersebut secara langsung, bencana yang hampir bersamaan tersebut menegangkan sumber daya nasional yang sudah terbatas oleh respons Flores, memerlukan BNPB untuk mengoordinasikan upaya bantuan di dua wilayah sekaligus.

segments.src: Seismologists note that such back-to-back events, while striking in their timing, are not unusual for Indonesia, which straddles the Pacific Ring of Fire — a horseshoe-shaped zone stretching around the Pacific Basin where the majority of the world's earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
segments.tr: Para seismolog mencatat bahwa peristiwa-peristiwa yang berurutan seperti itu, meskipun mencolok dalam waktunya, tidaklah tidak biasa bagi Indonesia, yang merentang di Cincin Api Pasifik — sebuah zona berbentuk tapal kuda yang membentang di sekitar Cekungan Pasifik di mana mayoritas gempa bumi dunia dan letusan vulkanik terjadi.

segments.src: The archipelago sits at the junction of several tectonic plates, making seismic activity a near-constant feature of life for its more than 270 million residents.
segments.tr: Kepulauan tersebut berada di persimpangan beberapa lempeng tektonik, menjadikan aktivitas seismik sebagai fitur kehidupan yang hampir konstan bagi lebih dari 270 juta penghuninya.

segments.src: ## Testing a Familiar System Under New Strain
segments.tr: ## Menguji Sistem yang Akrab di Bawah Tekanan Baru

segments.src: Indonesia has built one of the more experienced disaster-response frameworks in the world, shaped by decades of earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and the catastrophic 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
segments.tr: Indonesia telah membangun salah satu kerangka kerja respons bencana yang paling berpengalaman di dunia, dibentuk oleh puluhan tahun gempa bumi, letusan vulkanik, dan tsunami Samudra Hindia yang katastrofal pada tahun 2004.

segments.src: Early-warning networks, community evacuation drills, and rapid-deployment rescue units have all been refined in the years since.
segments.tr: Jaringan peringatan dini, latihan evakuasi komunitas, dan unit penyelamatan penyebaran cepat semuanya telah disempurnakan dalam beberapa tahun sejak saat itu.

segments.src: Even so, officials acknowledge that the combination of a high-magnitude quake, a prolonged aftershock sequence, and a second major event on the same day represents an unusually demanding scenario.
segments.tr: Namun demikian, para pejabat mengakui bahwa kombinasi gempa berkekuatan tinggi, urutan gempa susulan yang berkepanjangan, dan peristiwa utama kedua pada hari yang sama mewakili skenario yang luar biasa menuntut.

segments.src: The government has mobilized military and volunteer personnel to support local first responders, while international aid organizations have begun coordinating with Indonesian authorities to assess additional needs.
segments.tr: Pemerintah telah memobilisasi personel militer dan sukarelawan untuk mendukung responden pertama lokal, sementara organisasi bantuan internasional telah mulai berkoordinasi dengan otoritas Indonesia untuk menilai kebutuhan tambahan.

segments.src: Officials caution that damage assessments are still ongoing and that casualty and displacement figures may continue to rise as rescue teams reach areas that remain cut off.
segments.tr: Para pejabat memperingatkan bahwa penilaian kerusakan masih berlangsung dan bahwa angka korban dan pengungsi dapat terus meningkat saat tim penyelamatan mencapai area yang tetap terputus.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: For now, the focus remains on the immediate humanitarian response: reopening roads, stabilizing damaged buildings, and ensuring displaced families have access to shelter and medical care as aftershocks continue to ripple through the region.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, fokusnya tetap pada respons kemanusiaan segera: membuka kembali jalan, menstabilkan bangunan yang rusak, dan memastikan keluarga-keluarga yang kehilangan tempat tinggal memiliki akses ke tempat berlindung dan perawatan medis saat gempa susulan terus beriak di seluruh wilayah.

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: Jangka panjang, bencana ini diharapkan untuk memperbarui diskusi di sekitar kode bangunan, infrastruktur peringatan dini, dan pendanaan kesiapsiagaan di salah satu koridor paling aktif secara seismik di planet ini — pengingat bahwa bagi komunitas yang tinggal di sepanjang Cincin Api, ketangguhan bukanlah pencapaian satu kali tetapi upaya yang berkelanjutan.

ja.title: 一日に二度揺れた海岸：インドネシア・フローレス島を襲った地震の内側

segments.src: A powerful magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, killing more than 50 people and injuring hundreds more, according to national disaster officials.
segments.tr: インドネシア東部のフローレス島沖でマグニチュード7.7の大地震が発生し、国の災害当局によると50人以上が死亡し、数百人がけがをしたという。

segments.src: The quake, one of the strongest to hit the region in years, was followed by more than 230 aftershocks and, hours later, a second major tremor that shook the island of Sumatra thousands of kilometers away — turning a single day into one of the most severe tests of Indonesia's emergency response systems in recent memory.
segments.tr: この地震は数年来この地域を襲った最強クラスの揺れの一つで、230回以上の余震が続き、数時間後には数千キロメートル離れたスマトラ島を揺らした第2の大きな地震が発生した—わずか一日という期間で、インドネシアの緊急対応システムにとって近年稀に見る最大級の試練となった。

segments.src: ## A Sudden, Violent Shock
segments.tr: ## 突然の激しい揺れ

segments.src: The initial quake struck without warning, its epicenter located beneath the seabed near Flores, a mountainous island in the Nusa Tenggara region known for its volcanic terrain and small coastal communities.
segments.tr: 初期の地震は予告なく発生し、その震源地はフローレス島近くの海底下に位置していた。フローレス島はヌサテンガラ地域の山がちな島で、火山地形と小さな沿岸コミュニティで知られている。

segments.src: Indonesia's Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) issued a tsunami advisory in the immediate aftermath, prompting evacuations along low-lying shorelines before the warning was later downgraded.
segments.tr: インドネシアの気象気候地球物理庁（BMKG）は直後に津波注意報を発令し、低地の海岸線での避難を促したが、その後注意報は解除された。

segments.src: The shaking was strong enough to collapse older masonry buildings, damage schools and health clinics, and trigger landslides that buried sections of the island's main coastal roads.
segments.tr: この揺れは古いレンガ造りの建物を倒壊させ、学校と診療所に被害を与え、島の主要沿岸道路の一部を埋め尽くした地滑りを引き起こすほど強かった。

segments.src: Officials with Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) reported that thousands of residents were displaced, many now sheltering in temporary camps, mosques, and community halls as search-and-rescue teams work to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: インドネシア国家災害管理庁（BNPB）の当局者らは、数千人の住民が避難したと報告し、多くの人が仮設キャンプ、モスク、コミュニティホールに身を寄せており、捜索救助チームが孤立した村への到達を目指して活動している。

segments.src: ## Aftershocks Complicate the Response
segments.tr: ## 余震が対応を複雑にする

segments.src: What has made this disaster especially difficult to manage is the sheer volume of aftershocks that followed — more than 230 by some counts, according to seismic monitoring agencies.
segments.tr: この災害の対応を特に困難にしているのは、その後に続いた余震の数の多さである—地震監視機関によると、230回以上に達している。

segments.src: Each new tremor has slowed rescue efforts, forcing crews to repeatedly pause work on unstable structures and landslide-blocked routes out of concern for further collapses.
segments.tr: 新たな余震ごとに救助作業が遅れ、クルーはさらなる倒壊への懸念から、不安定な構造物と地滑りで塞がれた道路での作業を繰り返し中断することを余儀なくされた。

segments.src: Emergency responders have relied on heavy equipment to clear debris from roads connecting Flores' interior communities to coastal hospitals, but mountainous terrain and damaged infrastructure have made some areas reachable only on foot or by helicopter.
segments.tr: 緊急対応者は重機を使用してフローレスの内陸コミュニティから沿岸病院へつながる道路からがれきを撤去してきたが、山がちな地形と損傷したインフラにより、一部の地域は徒歩またはヘリコプターでしかアクセスできなくなった。

segments.src: Local authorities say the priority remains locating survivors, restoring access to remote villages, and delivering clean water, food, and medical supplies to displaced families.
segments.tr: 地方当局は、優先事項は生存者の捜索、遠隔地村へのアクセス復旧、避難した家族への清潔な水・食料・医療用品の供給であると述べている。

segments.src: ## A Second Quake, Far Away
segments.tr: ## 遠く離れた第2の地震

segments.src: Hours after the Flores earthquake, a separate significant tremor struck near Sumatra, an island more than 2,000 kilometers to the west.
segments.tr: フローレス地震の数時間後、西方2,000キロメートル以上離れた島スマトラ近くで別の大きな地震が発生した。

segments.src: While authorities have not linked the two events directly, the near-simultaneous disasters strained national resources already stretched thin by the Flores response, requiring BNPB to coordinate relief efforts across two regions at once.
segments.tr: 当局は2つの出来事を直接関連付けていないが、ほぼ同時の災害は、既にフローレス対応で限界に達していた国家資源をさらに緊迫させ、BNPBは一度に2つの地域にわたって救援活動を調整する必要があった。

segments.src: Seismologists note that such back-to-back events, while striking in their timing, are not unusual for Indonesia, which straddles the Pacific Ring of Fire — a horseshoe-shaped zone stretching around the Pacific Basin where the majority of the world's earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
segments.tr: 地震学者は、そのようなバックツーバックの出来事は、タイミングが驚くべきものではあるが、インドネシアにとっては珍しいことではないと指摘している。インドネシアは環太平洋火山帯をまたがっており、それは太平洋盆地の周りに広がる馬蹄形のゾーンであり、世界の地震と火山噴火の大部分がここで起きる。

segments.src: The archipelago sits at the junction of several tectonic plates, making seismic activity a near-constant feature of life for its more than 270 million residents.
segments.tr: この列島は複数のテクトニックプレートの交点に位置しており、地震活動は2億7000万人以上の住民の人生にほぼ常に存在する特徴となっている。

segments.src: ## Testing a Familiar System Under New Strain
segments.tr: ## 既存の災害対応システムが新たな試練に直面

segments.src: Indonesia has built one of the more experienced disaster-response frameworks in the world, shaped by decades of earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and the catastrophic 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
segments.tr: インドネシアは、数十年の地震、火山噴火、そして壊滅的な2004年インド洋津波によって形作られた、世界で最も経験豊かな災害対応フレームワークの1つを構築している。

segments.src: Early-warning networks, community evacuation drills, and rapid-deployment rescue units have all been refined in the years since.
segments.tr: 早期警報システム、地域避難訓練、迅速配備救助ユニットはすべてその後の年月で改善されてきた。

segments.src: Even so, officials acknowledge that the combination of a high-magnitude quake, a prolonged aftershock sequence, and a second major event on the same day represents an unusually demanding scenario.
segments.tr: それでも、当局は、高震度地震、長期の余震列、同日の第2の大きな出来事の組み合わせが通常でなく要求度の高いシナリオを示していることを認めている。

segments.src: The government has mobilized military and volunteer personnel to support local first responders, while international aid organizations have begun coordinating with Indonesian authorities to assess additional needs.
segments.tr: 政府は地方の初期対応者を支援するために軍事要員とボランティア要員を動員し、一方、国際援助機関はインドネシア当局と調整を開始して追加の必要性を評価している。

segments.src: Officials caution that damage assessments are still ongoing and that casualty and displacement figures may continue to rise as rescue teams reach areas that remain cut off.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next

segments.src: For now, the focus remains on the immediate humanitarian response: reopening roads, stabilizing damaged buildings, and ensuring displaced families have access to shelter and medical care as aftershocks continue to ripple through the region.

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: 長期的には、この災害は、地球上で最も地震活動が活発な地域の1つにおいて、建設基準、早期警報インフラ、および準備資金に関する議論を更新することが期待されている—環太平洋火山帯沿いで生活するコミュニティにとって、レジリエンスは一度限りの達成ではなく、継続的な努力であることを思い出させるものである。

de.title: Eine Küste bebte zweimal an einem Tag: Das Erdbeben, das Indonesiens Flores-Insel verwüstete

segments.src: A powerful magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, killing more than 50 people and injuring hundreds more, according to national disaster officials.
segments.tr: Ein starkes Erdbeben der Stärke 7,7 erschütterte die Küste der Flores-Insel in Ostindonesien und tötete nach Angaben der Katastrophenschutzbehörden mehr als 50 Menschen und verletzte hunderte weitere.

segments.src: The quake, one of the strongest to hit the region in years, was followed by more than 230 aftershocks and, hours later, a second major tremor that shook the island of Sumatra thousands of kilometers away — turning a single day into one of the most severe tests of Indonesia's emergency response systems in recent memory.
segments.tr: Das Erdbeben, eines der stärksten, das die Region in Jahren heimgesucht hat, wurde von mehr als 230 Nachbeben gefolgt, und Stunden später folgte ein zweites großes Beben, das die tausende Kilometer entfernte Insel Sumatra erschütterte – und verwandelte so einen einzigen Tag in einen der schwerwiegendsten Tests der Notfallreaktionssysteme Indonesiens in der jüngeren Geschichte.

segments.src: ## A Sudden, Violent Shock
segments.tr: ## Ein plötzlicher, gewaltsamer Schock

segments.src: The initial quake struck without warning, its epicenter located beneath the seabed near Flores, a mountainous island in the Nusa Tenggara region known for its volcanic terrain and small coastal communities.
segments.tr: Das anfängliche Erdbeben traf ohne Vorwarnung, mit seinem Epizentrum unter dem Meeresboden in der Nähe von Flores, einer bergigen Insel in der Region Nusa Tenggara, bekannt für ihr vulkanisches Gelände und kleine Küstengemeinden.

segments.src: Indonesia's Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) issued a tsunami advisory in the immediate aftermath, prompting evacuations along low-lying shorelines before the warning was later downgraded.
segments.tr: Indonesiens Meteorologische, Klimatologische und Geophysikalische Behörde (BMKG) gab unmittelbar nach dem Beben eine Tsunami-Warnung aus, die Evakuierungen entlang von tiefliegenden Küsten veranlasste, bevor die Warnung später zurückgenommen wurde.

segments.src: The shaking was strong enough to collapse older masonry buildings, damage schools and health clinics, and trigger landslides that buried sections of the island's main coastal roads.
segments.tr: Das Beben war stark genug, um ältere Steinbauten zum Einsturz zu bringen, Schulen und Gesundheitskliniken zu beschädigen und Erdrutsche auszulösen, die Teile der Hauptküstenstraßen der Insel verschütteten.

segments.src: Officials with Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) reported that thousands of residents were displaced, many now sheltering in temporary camps, mosques, and community halls as search-and-rescue teams work to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Beamte der Nationalen Katastrophenschutzbehörde Indonesiens (BNPB) berichteten, dass tausende Einwohner vertrieben wurden, von denen viele nun in provisorischen Lagern, Moscheen und Gemeindehallen Zuflucht suchten, während Such- und Rettungsteams daran arbeiten, isolierte Dörfer zu erreichen.

segments.src: ## Aftershocks Complicate the Response
segments.tr: ## Nachbeben erschweren die Reaktion

segments.src: What has made this disaster especially difficult to manage is the sheer volume of aftershocks that followed — more than 230 by some counts, according to seismic monitoring agencies.
segments.tr: Was diese Katastrophe besonders schwer zu bewältigen macht, ist die enorme Menge an Nachbeben, die folgten – mehr als 230 nach manchen Zählungen, laut erdbebenseismischer Überwachungsbehörden.

segments.src: Each new tremor has slowed rescue efforts, forcing crews to repeatedly pause work on unstable structures and landslide-blocked routes out of concern for further collapses.
segments.tr: Jedes neue Beben hat die Rettungsbemühungen verlangsamt, was Rettungsteams zwang, ihre Arbeiten an instabilen Strukturen und erdrutschversperrten Routen wiederholt zu unterbrechen aus Angst vor weiteren Einstürzen.

segments.src: Emergency responders have relied on heavy equipment to clear debris from roads connecting Flores' interior communities to coastal hospitals, but mountainous terrain and damaged infrastructure have made some areas reachable only on foot or by helicopter.
segments.tr: Rettungskräfte haben sich auf schweres Gerät verlassen, um Trümmer von Straßen zu räumen, die Flores' Innenlandsgemeinden mit Küstenkrankenhäusern verbinden, aber das bergige Gelände und die beschädigte Infrastruktur haben einige Gebiete nur zu Fuß oder per Hubschrauber erreichbar gemacht.

segments.src: Local authorities say the priority remains locating survivors, restoring access to remote villages, and delivering clean water, food, and medical supplies to displaced families.
segments.tr: Lokale Behörden sagen, dass die Priorität immer noch darin besteht, Überlebende zu finden, den Zugang zu entlegenen Dörfern wiederherzustellen und sauberes Wasser, Lebensmittel und medizinische Vorräte an vertriebene Familien zu liefern.

segments.src: ## A Second Quake, Far Away
segments.tr: ## Ein zweites Erdbeben, weit entfernt

segments.src: Hours after the Flores earthquake, a separate significant tremor struck near Sumatra, an island more than 2,000 kilometers to the west.
segments.tr: Stunden nach dem Flores-Erdbeben erschütterte ein separates bedeutsames Beben die Gegend in der Nähe von Sumatra, einer Insel mehr als 2.000 Kilometer westlich.

segments.src: While authorities have not linked the two events directly, the near-simultaneous disasters strained national resources already stretched thin by the Flores response, requiring BNPB to coordinate relief efforts across two regions at once.
segments.tr: Während die Behörden die beiden Ereignisse nicht direkt verknüpft haben, belasteten die fast gleichzeitigen Katastrophen nationale Ressourcen, die bereits durch die Flores-Reaktion dünn gestreckt waren, und erforderten von der BNPB, Hilfsmaßnahmen in zwei Regionen gleichzeitig zu koordinieren.

segments.src: Seismologists note that such back-to-back events, while striking in their timing, are not unusual for Indonesia, which straddles the Pacific Ring of Fire — a horseshoe-shaped zone stretching around the Pacific Basin where the majority of the world's earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
segments.tr: Seismologen bemerken, dass solche aufeinanderfolgenden Ereignisse, während sie in ihrem Timing auffällig sind, für Indonesien nicht ungewöhnlich sind, das den Pazifischen Feuerring umfasst – eine hufeisen förmige Zone, die sich um das Pazifische Becken erstreckt, wo die Mehrheit der Erdbeben und Vulkanausbrüche der Welt auftreten.

segments.src: The archipelago sits at the junction of several tectonic plates, making seismic activity a near-constant feature of life for its more than 270 million residents.
segments.tr: Der Archipel liegt an der Kreuzung mehrerer tektonischer Platten, was seismische Aktivität zu einem nahezu ständigen Merkmal des Lebens für seine mehr als 270 Millionen Einwohner macht.

segments.src: ## Testing a Familiar System Under New Strain
segments.tr: ## Ein vertrautes System unter neuer Belastung testen

segments.src: Indonesia has built one of the more experienced disaster-response frameworks in the world, shaped by decades of earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and the catastrophic 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
segments.tr: Indonesien hat eines der erfahreneren Katastrophenschutz-Frameworks der Welt aufgebaut, das durch Jahrzehnte von Erdbeben, Vulkanausbrüchen und dem katastrophalen Tsunami im Indischen Ozean von 2004 geprägt wurde.

segments.src: Early-warning networks, community evacuation drills, and rapid-deployment rescue units have all been refined in the years since.
segments.tr: Frühwarnsysteme, Evakuierungsübungen in Gemeinden und schnell einsetzbare Rettungseinheiten wurden alle in den Jahren seither verfeinert.

segments.src: Even so, officials acknowledge that the combination of a high-magnitude quake, a prolonged aftershock sequence, and a second major event on the same day represents an unusually demanding scenario.
segments.tr: Dennoch räumen Beamte ein, dass die Kombination aus einem starken Erdbeben, einer langen Nachbebenserie und einem zweiten Hauptereignis am selben Tag ein ungewöhnlich anspruchsvolles Szenario darstellt.

segments.src: The government has mobilized military and volunteer personnel to support local first responders, while international aid organizations have begun coordinating with Indonesian authorities to assess additional needs.
segments.tr: Die Regierung hat Militär- und Freiwilligenpersonal mobilisiert, um lokale Erste-Hilfe-Anbieter zu unterstützen, während internationale Hilfsorganisationen begonnen haben, mit den indonesischen Behörden zu koordinieren, um zusätzliche Bedürfnisse zu bewerten.

segments.src: Officials caution that damage assessments are still ongoing and that casualty and displacement figures may continue to rise as rescue teams reach areas that remain cut off.
segments.tr: Beamte warnen davor, dass Schadensabschätzungen noch laufen und dass Opfer- und Vertreibungszahlen weiterhin ansteigen können, wenn Rettungsteams Gebiete erreichen, die abgeschnitten bleiben.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Was kommt als nächstes

segments.src: For now, the focus remains on the immediate humanitarian response: reopening roads, stabilizing damaged buildings, and ensuring displaced families have access to shelter and medical care as aftershocks continue to ripple through the region.
segments.tr: Vorerst bleibt der Fokus auf der unmittelbaren humanitären Reaktion: Straßen wieder öffnen, beschädigte Gebäude stabilisieren und sicherstellen, dass vertriebene Familien Zugang zu Unterkunft und medizinischer Versorgung haben, während die Nachbeben weiterhin durch die Region rollen.

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: Mittelfristig wird erwartet, dass die Katastrophe die Diskussion um Bauvorschriften, Frühwarnsysteme und Vorbereitungsmittel in einem der seismisch aktivsten Korridore des Planeten erneuert – eine Erinnerung daran, dass für Gemeinden, die entlang des Feuerrings leben, Widerstandsfähigkeit nicht ein einmaliger Erfolg ist, sondern ein laufender Aufwand.

segments.tr: Hiện tại, trọng tâm vẫn là phản ứng nhân đạo ngay lập tức: mở lại các con đường, ổn định các tòa nhà bị hư hại, và đảm bảo các gia đình bị chuyển chỗ có quyền truy cập vào nơi trú ẩn và chăm sóc y tế khi các dư chấn tiếp tục lan tỏa khắp khu vực.

segments.src: Longer term, the disaster is expected to renew discussion around building codes, early-warning infrastructure, and preparedness funding in one of the most seismically active corridors on the planet — a reminder that for communities living along the Ring of Fire, resilience is not a one-time achievement but an ongoing effort.
segments.tr: Trong dài hạn, thảm họa dự kiến sẽ làm sôi nổi lại cuộc thảo luận xung quanh các quy tắc xây dựng, cơ sở hạ tầng cảnh báo sớm, và tài trợ cho sự chuẩn bị trong một trong những hành lang hoạt động địa chấn tích cực nhất trên hành tinh — một lời nhắc nhở rằng đối với các cộng đồng sống dọc theo Vành đai Lửa, khả năng phục hồi không phải là một thành tựu một lần mà là một nỗ lực liên tục.
